snippet.text: theorem scaledCutoff_iteratedDeriv (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : iteratedDeriv n (scaledCutoff a) = fun q => a ^ n * iteratedDeriv n cutoff (a * q), where scaledCutoff a q = cutoff (a * q) (line 134) — with a = ρ⁻¹ this is ∂_X^r[β(X/ρ)] = ρ^{-r} β^{(r)}(X/ρ). Docstring: 'The exact all-order chain rule for the scale used in Sections 7 and 11.'
